id: \bWhat a miraculous moment to see these eight Champions from far and wide, gathered in one place. This is the true thrill of the World Coronation Series.
en: \bWhat a miraculous moment to see these eight Champions from far and wide, gathered in one place.  This is the true thrill of the World Coronation Series.
it: \bChe momento miracoloso, vedere questi otto Campioni giunti da ogni dove riuniti in un unico luogo.  Questo è il vero brivido delle World Coronation Series.

id: \bYour first match has been decided. You will be facing Steven. Please speak to me when you are ready.
en: \bYour first match has been decided. You will be facing Steven. Please speak to me when you are ready.
it: \bIl tuo primo incontro è stato deciso. Affronterai Rocco. Parla con me quando sei pronto.

id: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Vanilla Cream Alcremie?
en: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Vanilla Cream Alcremie?
it: \bVuoi far evolvere il tuo Milcery in un Alcremie Lattecrema Vaniglia?

id: \bAlright, let's give it a quick clockwise spin...
en: \bAlright, let's give it a quick clockwise spin...
it: \bBene, facciamogli fare una piroetta rapida in senso orario...

id: \b...And done! Now just give it a sweet and level it up for it to evolve.
en: \b...And done! Now just give it a sweet and level it up for it to evolve.
it: \b...Fatto! Ora dagli un dolcetto e fallo salire di livello per farlo evolvere.

id: \bSorry, I can't do anything for you if you don't have an Milcery.
en: \bSorry, I can't do anything for you if you don't have an Milcery.
it: \bMi spiace, non posso fare niente per te se non hai un Milcery.

id: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Macha Cream Alcremie?
en: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Macha Cream Alcremie?
it: \bVuoi far evolvere il tuo Milcery in un Alcremie Panna Matcha?

id: \bRaihan: I don't care what type of challenge it is. I won't lose.
en: \bRaihan: I don't care what type of challenge it is. I won't lose.
it: \bRaihan: Non m'importa che tipo di sfida sia. Non perderò.

id: \bGoh: This wasn't as bad as I thought it'd be.
en: \bGoh: This wasn't as bad as I thought it'd be.
it: \bGoh: Non è andata male come pensavo.

id: \bFirst, ranked eighth: The shining first Champion of the Alola region's first-ever league. Hailing from Pallet Town, Competitor \PN!
en: \bFirst, ranked eighth: The shining first Champion of the Alola region's first-ever league. Hailing from Pallet Town, Competitor \PN!
it: \bPer primo, all'ottavo posto: lo splendente primo Campione della prima Lega in assoluto della regione di Alola. Da Biancavilla, lo sfidante \PN!

id: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Ruby Cream Alcremie?

it: \bVuoi far evolvere il tuo Milcery in un Alcremie Panna Rubino?

id: \bAlright, let's give it a quick counterclockwise spin...
en: \bAlright, let's give it a quick counterclockwise spin...
it: \bBene, facciamogli fare una piroetta rapida in senso antiorario...

en: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Salted Cream Alcremie?
it: \bVuoi far evolvere il tuo Milcery in un Alcremie Panna Salata?

id: \bRanked seventh: Aiming to be a Dragon Master, and still growing even stronger. The young Champion of Unova, Competitor Iris!
en: \bRanked seventh: Aiming to be a Dragon Master, and still growing even stronger. The young Champion of Unova, Competitor Iris!
it: \bAl settimo posto: punta a diventare Maestra dei Draghi e continua a farsi sempre più forte. La giovane Campionessa di Unima, la sfidante Iris!

id: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Mint Cream Alcremie?

id: \bRanked sixth: An adventurer renowned for excavating Mega Stones. The winner of the Kalos League Lumiose Conference, Competitor Alain!
en: \bRanked sixth: An adventurer renowned for excavating Mega Stones. The winner of the Kalos League Lumiose Conference, Competitor Alain!
it: \bAl sesto posto: un avventuriero famoso per i suoi scavi di Megapietre. Il vincitore della Conferenza di Luminopoli della Lega di Kalos, lo sfidante Alain!

id: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Lemon Cream Alcremie?
en: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Lemon Cream Alcremie?
it: \bVuoi far evolvere il tuo Milcery in un Alcremie Panna Limone?

id: \bAlright, let's give it a longer clockwise spin...

en: \bWant to make your Milcery evolve into a Caramel Swirl Alcremie?

id: \bRanked fifth: A world-renowned actress enters the stage. Just as skilled in battle as on camera, she is the Champion of Kalos, Competitor Diantha!
en: \bRanked fifth: A world-renowned actress enters the stage. Just as skilled in battle as on camera, she is the Champion of Kalos, Competitor Diantha!
it: \bAl quinto posto: un'attrice di fama mondiale sale sul palco. Abile in lotta tanto quanto davanti alla telecamera, è la Campionessa di Kalos, la sfidante Diantha!

id: \bRanked fourth: The new Champion of Kanto and Johto. One of the Pokémon G-Men fighting evil far and near. Competitor Lance!
en: \bRanked fourth: The new Champion of Kanto and Johto. One of the Pokémon G-Men fighting evil far and near. Competitor Lance!
it: \bAl quarto posto: il nuovo Campione di Kanto e Johto. Uno dei G-Men Pokémon che combattono il male ovunque. Lo sfidante Lance!

id: \rOpal: Ah, you decided to show up after all. I've decided it's time for a cake battle. Let's begin.
en: \rOpal: Ah, you decided to show up after all. I've decided it's time for a cake battle. Let's begin.
it: \rOpal: Ah, alla fine ti sei fatto vedere. Ho deciso che è il momento di una lotta a base di torte. Cominciamo.

id: \rOpal: I see you're quite the battler. Well, that's it. Clear out.
en: \rOpal: I see you're quite the battler. Well, that's it.  Clear out.
it: \rOpal: Vedo che sei proprio un bravo lottatore. Bene, è tutto.  Sgombrate.

id: \bGoh: That was...interesting.
en: \bGoh: That was...interesting.
it: \bGoh: È stato...interessante.

id: \bRanked third: The heir to Hoenn's Devon Corporation and Champion of Hoenn, Competitor Steven!
en: \bRanked third: The heir to Hoenn's Devon Corporation and Champion of Hoenn, Competitor Steven!
it: \bAl terzo posto: l'erede della Devon SpA di Hoenn e Campione di Hoenn, lo sfidante Rocco!

id: \bRanked second: The authority on Pokémon aracheology and Champion of Sinnoh, Competitor Cynthia!
en: \bRanked second: The authority on Pokémon aracheology and Champion of Sinnoh, Competitor Cynthia!
it: \bAl secondo posto: l'autorità in materia di archeologia Pokémon e Campionessa di Sinnoh, la sfidante Camilla!

id: \bAnd ranked first: The Champion of Galar, and reigning Monarch of the Pokémon World Coronation Series.
en: \bAnd ranked first: The Champion of Galar, and reigning Monarch of the Pokémon World Coronation Series.
it: \bE al primo posto: il Campione di Galar e Monarca in carica delle World Coronation Series Pokémon.

id: \bThe world's strongest...\nThe unbeaten... \nCompetitor Leon!
en: \bThe world's strongest...\nThe unbeaten... \nCompetitor Leon!
it: \bIl più forte del mondo...\nL'imbattuto... \nLo sfidante Dandel!

id: \bLeon: Opal's always doing a new type of tournament. It's best to just go along.
en: \bLeon: Opal's always doing a new type of tournament. It's best to just go along.
it: \bDandel: Poppy si inventa sempre un nuovo tipo di torneo. Conviene assecondarla.
